description: Rule-level suppressions for the Java doctor-curated pass. Each entry needs a written reason.

suppressions.reason: Classic FindBugs/SpotBugs noise for JPA entities and DTOs that return mutable field references; not a default P1 for Ezkey. Revisit when auditing a security-sensitive type.
Same family as EI_EXPOSE_REP (store mutable reference into field). Default suppress for entity/DTO posture; unsuppress for targeted review.
Intentional: JPA entity listeners are not Spring-managed; EncryptionOperations is injected into a static field by design (documented on the class). See hygiene/java-doctor/2026-07-11-pass-1.md.
One-shot SecureRandom in generateHmacKeyFile (first-startup keyfile bootstrap), not a hot path. Acceptable; see hygiene/java-doctor/2026-07-11-pass-1.md.

Harmless local over-defense (normalizePath length check; toUnsignedLong MAX_VALUE after negative branch). Redundancy is obvious within 3–4 lines; leave as-is — no test churn for zero product gain. See hygiene/java-doctor/2026-07-11-pass-1.md and AGENTS.md HITL if-it-ain't-broken rule.
